newsitem.title: UK: IEA sees light Euro, US autumn refinery shutdowns.
newsitem.headline: IEA sees light Euro, US autumn refinery shutdowns.

text.p: Refinery maintenance in Europe and the United States this autumn is scheduled much lighter than last year, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday.
"In particular in the U.S., maintenance shutdowns are projected this autumn to be at the lowest level for more than five years," the IEA said in its monthly oil market report.
It said it expected just 190,000 bpd of U.S. refinery shutdowns in September, rising to 290,000 bpd and 280,000 bpd in November and December.

European refinery maintenance was expected to reach just half of last year's level this autumn following maintenance carried out together with the commissioning of additional hydro-desulphurisation capacity ahead of new low sulphur diesel in EU countries in October.
European refiners were expected to shut down about 600,000 bpd in September, 400,000 bpd in October and 300,000 bpd in November, the IEA said.
Japanese maintenance is expected to shut 520,000 bpd in September, 690,000 bpd in October and 160,000 bpd in November.
South Korea and Indonesia combined are expected to shut 350,000 bpd in September, 280,000 bpd in October and 130,000 bpd in November.
India is expected to shut 80,000 bpd in September, the IEA said.
